rationale: C107 flagged negative cost values for review, but the raw schedule of investments prints the sampled flagged amounts as parenthesized negative cost values on revolving or delayed-draw debt lines. For example, MRO Holdings, Inc. shows a revolver with cost (776) and fair value (213), matching the extracted -776000 cost, and Triumph/TITAN rows similarly show costs (79) and (315). The source therefore supports the stored sign rather than proving a data error; the rule is a monitoring warning on legitimate negative costs.
